clips.title: The story
paras: Young Darkspear priests leave the Valley of Trials under Ken'jai's direction. They report to Tai'jin in Razor Hill and take their first steps into Durotar's wider challenges. Their path balances ancestral troll heritage with life in the Horde.

Darkspear acolytes leave the Valley of Trials after learning their basic rites under Ken'jai. The paths out of the secluded training grounds lead to Razor Hill, a crossroads settlement in Durotar. For a young priest, the journey marks a step beyond basic survival drills and toward the spiritual and cultural responsibilities of the tribe.

Ken'jai speaks plainly about the Darkspear's place in Thrall's Horde. The trolls value the orcs' loyalty and lessons of honor, yet some ancestral traditions sit uneasily among their allies. Darkspear spiritual leaders teach their pupils to preserve their heritage quietly while serving the Horde. At Razor Hill, Tai'jin welcomes the acolytes and guides them toward self-sufficiency and strength within the community.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Aye, mon. Our kind have joined the Horde because they be good for us. They loyal, and they teach us much 'bout tings like honor. But our old ways die hard. The orcs may not approve of all our traditions, but that not mean we can't continue to practice some them in secret.
You know this, an' that's why I send you to Tai'jin in Razor Hill. She teach you more 'bout our history. She teach you the ways of our tribe. Go to her when you be ready.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahh... So you finally come to Tai'jin. This be good.

You already know that we are not da same tribe that once joined with the Horde. We be much stronger now. We stronger 'cause we adapt--the Horde teach us that much. We no longer defeat our enemies and gain strength from them; now we gain strength, and then defeat our enemies.
The difference be subtle, but you will learn. You will see. The tribe count on you to learn such things.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
